tasks.summary_pl: Zbiornik $144$m³, dno kwadrat, boki$\le9$m. Min koszt: bok dna + wys.
tasks.summary_en: Tank $144$m³, square base, dims$\le9$m. Min cost: base edge + height
tasks.statement_en: A certain plant received an order to build a rectangular cuboid tank (completely open at the top) with a capacity of $144\text{ m}^3$. The base of the tank is to be a square. None of the dimensions (edges of the cuboid) may exceed $9$ meters. The total cost of construction was set as follows: $100$ PLN per $1\text{ m}^2$ of the base, $75$ PLN per $1\text{ m}^2$ of a side wall. Find the dimensions of the tank for which the cost of construction, set this way, is smallest.
